title: Spectral decomposition of $(\star,ε_1,ε_2)$-structured matrix polynomials
summary: We provide the spectral decompositions of $(\star,ε_1,ε_2)$-structured matrix polynomials $P(λ)$ in the unified form by a standard pair $(X, J)$ and a parameter matrix $Γ$. Using the recursive relationship between the coefficient matrices of $P(λ)$, equivalent expressions of these coefficient matrices are provided. When $J$ is assumed to be a block diagonal matrix, we show that the parameter matrix $Γ$ has a special structure.
